readout_other: BOLD EPI with SPM analysis; MR-ARFI; MR thermometry; SNR, g-factor and tSNR
direction_notes: Preliminary demonstration: the BOLD time course at the posterior cingulate target increased with stimulation and gradually fell to the unstimulated level; no statistics on neural direction.
safety_notes: MR thermometry showed a mean temperature rise of 0.01 C in the ROI with a maximum of 0.2233 C.

device.model: custom-designed, homemade MRI-compatible single crystal-based ultrasound transducer

timing.protocol_description: Sine wave, 300 kHz, PRF 200 Hz, pulse duty cycle 10%, stimulus duration 1 s and stimulus duty cycle 50%. Each fMRI stimulation lasted 30 seconds with a 10-second pause after each.

source_quotes.n_subjects: In this in vivo study, four male rhesus monkeys (Macaca mulatta; 7 years old, 20 kg; 7 years old, 8.4 kg; 5 years old, 6.6 kg; and 5 years old, 6.4 kg) were used following protocols approved by the Animal Care and Use Committees at the Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology (SIAT), Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), China.
